item.title: RTT: Public selection for the recruitment of a tenure-track RTT researcher with a fixed-term employment contract pursuant to art. 24, Law 240/2010 (Ref. 2668) (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-12 13:00
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/PEMM-01 Arti performative, musicali, cinematografiche e mediali

Continuation and development of the Hyperstage project (PRIN 2022), involving the implementation of digital data for new theatrical productions through the study of literary texts and iconographic documents, with the aim of semantically reconstructing them in accordance with the knowledge base ontology already published via open access.

item.title: RTT: ITAL-01/A LETTERATURA ITALIANA (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Brescia
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ITAL-01 Letteratura italiana

The researcher will study the works and authors of Italian literary culture across the entire chronological span and from a historical perspective that connects past and present, possibly broadening the investigation to include works in other languages and dialects, produced in Italy and abroad, that relate to the Italian historical and cultural context.

item.title: RTT: 10/ARTE-01 ART HISTORY (Univ. Catt. S.Cuore)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-02 16:00
Institution: Univ. Catt. S.Cuore, Milano
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/ARTE-01 Storia dell'arte

The selected candidate will be expected to conduct research and produce scholarly publications in the fields of Museology, Art Criticism, and Conservation-Restoration Studies, with particular reference to the history of collecting and museums, museum audience studies and curatorial practices, art criticism, the history of conservation and restoration, and the application of diagnostic techniques to works of art in their historical development.

item.title: RTT: Ref. 5372, Ann. 3 - Italian between the twentieth century and the new millennium: from the description of the system to educational applications (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-10-26 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Classics, philology, literature, art history / 10/LIFI-01 Linguistica e filologia italiana

"From a research perspective, the RTT will conduct studies and in-depth investigations into the processes of Italianization that characterized the twentieth century, taking into account the role played in it by the literary language past and present and examining them in relation to the transformations that have occurred and are still ongoing within the linguistic system. Particular attention will be devoted to the educational implications of these phenomena and to their application in the development of language skills in contemporary schools.
